data.description: ## Testing Mode GREEN ## Overview Insert the entry and exit validator invocation blocks into COMMIT-WORKFLOW.md. Makes T7's RED tests pass. Entry check reads upstream sprint PRECONDITIONS; exit write emits commit's own PRECONDITIONS event. ## File Impact - Modify: plugins/dso/docs/workflows/COMMIT-WORKFLOW.md ## Implementation Notes **Entry section** — insert in Step 0 (Gather Context), after the Breadcrumb Init block: ```bash # Stage-boundary preconditions entry check (Story 4) source "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/lib/preconditions-validator-lib.sh" 2>/dev/null || true _dso_pv_entry_check "commit" "sprint" "${STORY_OR_EPIC_ID:-}" || true # Fail-open: diagnostic emitted on missing/invalid upstream PRECONDITIONS; commit proceeds ``` **Exit section** — insert in the final step (after review record, before push): ```bash # Stage-boundary preconditions exit write (Story 4) _dso_pv_exit_write "commit" "${_UPSTREAM_EVENT_ID:-}" "${DIFF_HASH:-}" "${STORY_OR_EPIC_ID:-}" || true ``` Both fail-open. Zero user interaction. ## Acceptance Criteria - [ ] All 4 tests from T7 PASS after this edit   Verify: bash $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/skills/test-preconditions-commit-validator.sh 2>&1 | grep -v FAIL | grep -q "pass\|ok\|PASS" - [ ] Entry section references _dso_pv_entry_check with "commit" and "sprint"   Verify: grep -q '_dso_pv_entry_check.*commit.*sprint\|_dso_pv_entry_check.*"commit"' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/docs/workflows/COMMIT-WORKFLOW.md - [ ] Exit section references _dso_pv_exit_write with "commit"   Verify: grep -q '_dso_pv_exit_write.*commit' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/docs/workflows/COMMIT-WORKFLOW.md - [ ] check-referential-integrity.sh passes   Verify: bash $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/scripts/check-referential-integrity.sh 2>&1 | grep -v "^$" | tail -1 | grep -qi "ok\|pass\|0 errors" - [ ] validate.sh --ci passes   Verify: bash $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/scripts/validate.sh --ci ## Retry Budget MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model) On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
data.title: Add preconditions-validator-lib entry/exit hooks to COMMIT-WORKFLOW.md
